title: Shulkerwave | End Music Disc
description: End Cities have a new music disc!
body:
This small Data Pack adds a new music disc that can be found in End Cities that plays a new End-themed song called Shulkerwave!

---

<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/6iFkU0PtMFQ" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

Shulkerwave is a music track originally made in 2024 for an old Data Pack focused on overhauling the End dimension, which was then discontinued. However, I still wanted to release Shulkerwave in some way and finally ended up releasing it in the form of a smaller Data Pack to make it appear as loot in the End Cities!

---

### INSTALLATION
To work properly and play the new track, the Data Pack requires the installation of a Resource Pack. In the Versions page, be sure to go in the specific Release page and download both the Data Pack and the Resource Pack!

---

### COMPATIBILITY
On the technical side, the Data Pack replaces vanilla loot tables by adding an extra entry for the music disc, that way no existing loot is replaced by the Music Disc, however, this makes the Data Pack incompatible with any other packs that change the End City loot table.
